connectors.title: Weather alerts (NWS, by point)
connectors.description: active emergency alerts and weather warnings for the place (National Weather Service, US)
connectors.attribution: Alerts from the US National Weather Service (weather.gov)

connectors.title: Avalanche danger near the place (avalanche.org)
connectors.description: current avalanche danger rating (1 low to 5 extreme) and travel advice for the forecast zones that contain the place or lie within 50 miles of it (default), nearest first, with the forecast's valid period and a link to the full forecast (US)
connectors.attribution: Avalanche forecasts from the regional avalanche centers via avalanche.org; read the full forecast at the link before travelling in avalanche terrain
connectors.license: Forecast data of the regional avalanche centers; see each center for terms

connectors.title: Earthquakes near the place, past day (USGS feed)
connectors.description: magnitude 2.5 or more earthquakes of the past day within 500 miles of the place (default), nearest first, from the USGS worldwide summary feed (USGS)
connectors.attribution: Earthquake data from the US Geological Survey (earthquake.usgs.gov), public domain

connectors.title: Earthquakes near the place (USGS)
connectors.description: recent earthquakes of magnitude 2 or more near the place (300 km by default), newest first, with distance and direction (USGS)
connectors.attribution: Earthquake data from the US Geological Survey (earthquake.usgs.gov), public domain

connectors.title: Satellite fire detections near the place (NASA FIRMS)
connectors.description: VIIRS satellite hotspots (possible fires) detected in the last day within 100 km of the place (default), nearest first, with time, confidence and fire power; needs a free NASA FIRMS map key
connectors.attribution: Active fire data from NASA LANCE / FIRMS (firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov), VIIRS; a detection is a hot spot seen from orbit, not a confirmed fire
connectors.license: NASA open data; the FIRMS API needs a free MAP_KEY

connectors.title: Wildfires near the place (WFIGS)
connectors.description: current wildfire incidents within 150 miles of the place (default), largest first, with size, containment, county, discovery time and distance (US, NIFC WFIGS)
connectors.attribution: Wildfire incidents from the National Interagency Fire Center WFIGS (data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com), public domain

connectors.title: Wildfire perimeters near the place (WFIGS)
connectors.description: current wildfire perimeters within 150 miles of the place (default), nearest edge first, with distance and direction from the place to the fire edge (US, NIFC WFIGS)
connectors.attribution: Wildfire perimeters from the National Interagency Fire Center WFIGS (data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com), public domain

connectors.title: River forecast for one gauge (NWPS)
connectors.description: the latest observed reading and the forecast stage and flow for one NWS river gauge, chosen by its id such as BIGI1 (US, NOAA NWPS)
connectors.attribution: River gauge data and forecasts from the NOAA National Water Prediction Service (water.noaa.gov), public domain

connectors.title: River gauges near the place (NWPS)
connectors.description: NWS river forecast gauges within 40 miles of the place (default), nearest first: the latest observed stage and flow (kcfs = thousand cubic feet per second), the next forecast and the flood category (US, NOAA NWPS)
connectors.attribution: River gauge data and forecasts from the NOAA National Water Prediction Service (water.noaa.gov), public domain

connectors.title: River flow and gage height near the place, Idaho (USGS)
connectors.description: latest river discharge (cfs) and gage height (ft) at active USGS stream gages in Idaho within 60 miles of the place (default), nearest first (USGS)
connectors.attribution: Water data from the US Geological Survey (waterservices.usgs.gov), public domain; provisional data is subject to revision
connectors.license: US Government work, public domain; provisional data subject to revision

connectors.title: Idaho 511 traffic events near the place
connectors.description: Idaho road events from 511 within 75 miles of the place (default): closures, crashes, incidents and roadwork, full closures first then nearest; needs a free 511 developer key
connectors.attribution: Road event data from Idaho 511 (511.idaho.gov), Idaho Transportation Department; use is subject to the 511 developer terms

connectors.title: Idaho 511 winter road conditions
connectors.description: statewide Idaho winter road conditions from 511 (dry, wet, snow, ice, closed) by road section; the same list for every place; needs a free 511 developer key
connectors.attribution: Road condition data from Idaho 511 (511.idaho.gov), Idaho Transportation Department; use is subject to the 511 developer terms

connectors.title: Road work zones near the place, Idaho (WZDx)
connectors.description: Idaho road work zones and lane closures from the national WZDx feed within 50 miles of the place (default), most restrictive first then nearest
connectors.attribution: Work zone data from the Idaho Transportation Department (511.idaho.gov) in the USDOT WZDx format
connectors.license: Idaho Transportation Department open data (WZDx feed); see 511.idaho.gov terms

connectors.title: Space weather alerts (NOAA)
connectors.description: recent NOAA space weather alerts, watches and warnings (solar flares, radiation storms, geomagnetic storms, radio blackouts), newest first; not tied to a place
connectors.attribution: Space weather data from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (swpc.noaa.gov), US Government work

connectors.title: Solar flux F10.7 (NOAA)
connectors.description: 10.7 cm solar radio flux (a measure of solar activity that sets HF radio conditions), newest first; not tied to a place
connectors.attribution: Space weather data from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (swpc.noaa.gov), US Government work

connectors.title: Geomagnetic Kp index (NOAA)
connectors.description: planetary Kp index (geomagnetic activity, 0 quiet to 9 extreme storm), newest first, 3-hourly; not tied to a place
connectors.attribution: Space weather data from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (swpc.noaa.gov), US Government work

connectors.title: Space weather scales (NOAA)
connectors.description: current NOAA space weather scales (radio blackouts R, solar radiation storms S, geomagnetic storms G) and the 3-day outlook; not tied to a place
connectors.attribution: Space weather data from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (swpc.noaa.gov), US Government work

connectors.title: Traffic flow at the place (TomTom)
connectors.description: live traffic speed on the road segment nearest the place compared with free-flow speed, and whether the road is closed (TomTom; needs a free TomTom key)
connectors.attribution: Traffic data by TomTom (tomtom.com); use is subject to the TomTom developer terms
connectors.license: TomTom developer terms (free key, 2,500 requests/day free)

connectors.title: Weather forecast (NWS, by point)
connectors.description: National Weather Service forecast for the place in 12-hour periods for about a week: temperature, wind, chance of rain and the written forecast (US only; two requests: the point, then its forecast)
connectors.attribution: Forecasts from the US National Weather Service (weather.gov)

connectors.title: Current conditions (NWS stations near the place)
connectors.description: latest observations from the nearest National Weather Service stations (up to three that reported in the last 12 hours): temperature, wind, humidity, pressure and sky (US only; the station list, then each station's latest report)
connectors.attribution: Observations from the US National Weather Service (weather.gov)

connectors.title: Weather forecast (Open-Meteo)
connectors.description: weather forecast for the place: current conditions and a 16-day outlook with highs, lows, rain chance, rain and snow amounts, wind (Open-Meteo, worldwide)
connectors.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0)
